# Carcavelos Forecast – 24 Sept 2026

**Small but clean – grab it early before the afternoon wind kicks in.**

**Morning (4:33–11:00):** Your best bet. Light northerly winds keep conditions glassy through 11am, with 1.3–1.4m waves and a solid 10-second swell. Head out between 6–9am when wind is minimal (3–5km/h) and water temps hover around 17°C. Expect a mellow, peeling right-hander favoring intermediate surfers.

**Progression:** Waves gradually fade from 1.4m to 1.2m as the afternoon approaches. Wind direction shifts to SSW by midday, maintaining offshore-ish quality until around 3pm.

**Afternoon (12:00–17:00):** Winds build to 6–7km/h mid-afternoon, roughing up the face. By 5pm, NNW wind picks up to 11km/h—session done.

**Tips:** Bring a shortboard or funboard; small swell favours manoeuvrability. Skip the afternoon unless you're chasing a late sesh. Early bird scores the cleanest lines.
